mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.2% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes and reduce real interest rate pressures, boosting equity valuations and generating positive forward 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.2% for 3 months, or the mean return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which triggers a policy response from the Fed and reduces real yields, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.5 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of Fed rate cuts and reduces real interest rates, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive forward 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 455 billion dollars, combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.1 million units, signals strong underlying demand momentum, which may lead to inflationary pressures and a Fed tightening, resulting in negative forward 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS > 455000 and HOUST > 1100, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 238.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, increasing the probability of a Fed rate hike, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative forward 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 238.0 and 12-month growth > 3.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 250,000 jobs per month, combined with a stable unemployment rate below 5.0%, indicates a tight labor market that may force the Fed to maintain higher rates, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative forward 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 250000 and UNRATE < 5.0%, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized over two consecutive quarters signals an impending recession, which triggers a policy response from the Fed and reduces real yields, leading to positive forward 60-day S&P 500 returns as markets price in eventual stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 1.5% for two quarters, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
